description: The transcripts of LibriTTS-R. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are LibriTTS-R's per-chapter `.trans.tsv` files, inside archives that total about 87 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
